column2: A two-storey half-timbered townhouse: white plaster walls between dark oak timber framing, a jettied upper floor that overhangs the ground floor on carved brackets, a steep red clay-tile roof with one gabled dormer, a stone chimney, a low stone plinth course, small leaded windows with wooden shutters, window boxes of red flowers under the upper windows, a plank front door.

A one-and-a-half-storey thatched cottage: a thick rounded golden straw thatch roof with a neat ridge and one small thatched eyebrow dormer, cream plaster walls with dark timber framing over a rough stone base, small warm-lit windows, a plank door, a window box of red flowers.

A larger three-storey timber-framed merchant's house: white plaster and dark oak framing with decorative cross braces, each upper floor jettied out over the one below, a steep red clay-tile roof with two dormers and a stone chimney, a stone ground floor with an arched shop door, a wrought-iron bracket holding a hanging wooden shop sign painted with a plain golden key, window boxes of red flowers.

A village smithy: an open-fronted timber lean-to workshop on thick oak posts under a red clay-tile roof, a stone back wall with a brick-and-stone forge hearth glowing orange and a tall stone chimney, an iron anvil on a tree stump in front, a water trough, hammers, tongs and horseshoes hanging on a rack on the wall, one red cloth banner with a black eagle hanging from the front beam.

A single wooden market stall: four sturdy timber posts carrying a red-and-white striped cloth awning with a scalloped edge, a plank counter piled with red apples, green cabbages, and golden cheese wheels, wicker baskets and wooden crates of produce stacked at its foot.

A round village well: a ring of chunky dressed grey stone blocks, two timber posts carrying a small steep red clay-tile roof, a wooden crank axle with an iron handle and a rope down to a wooden bucket resting on the stone rim.

A monument of a king: a stone-and-gilt statue of a bearded king standing tall in plate armour with a gilt crown, a long red cloak, both hands resting on a great sword point-down, standing on a tall dressed grey stone plinth with moulded cornices and a carved panel showing a red banner with a black eagle on the front. One solid monument, the plinth taller than a man.

A two-wheeled wooden market cart with no horse, its shafts resting on the ground: plank sides, big spoked wooden wheels with iron rims, loaded with plump tied burlap sacks and two oak barrels with iron hoops.
